title: T81 Foundation Reference Performance Baseline Manifest

cmp3_decision_advantage.reason: Protocol Section 7 requires formal maintainer Ed25519 signing and R01-R11 repairs; PMU hardware counters blocked.

h04_r03_phase_c.reason: Linux feasibility audit confirms exact process RSS enforcement is unsatisfied on stock Linux; fail-closed execution freeze enforced.

h01_physical_storage.reason: Matched characterization data unavailable in silicon.

h02_arithmetic_closure.reason: Software ternary arithmetic suffers net slowdown compared to native binary ALUs on conventional CPUs.

workloads.purpose: Horner MSB-first balanced ternary conversion for signed 64-bit integers on a binary host CPU
workloads.correctness_oracle: Round-trip identity decode_i64(encode_i64(x)) == x across [-2^63, 2^63-1] and Horner saturation bounds in tests/cpp/ternary_arith_test.cpp
workloads.proposed_measurement_method: High-resolution monotonic timer (std::chrono::steady_clock) measuring per-conversion latency over 100,000 iterations
workloads.environment_requirements: Single isolated physical core, CPU frequency governor performance, x86_64 or AArch64
workloads.freeze_overlap: None. Distinct from H04-R03 and CMP3.

workloads.purpose: Multi-tryte limb Booth multiplication on a conventional binary host
workloads.correctness_oracle: Limb multiplication correctness assertions in tests/cpp/test_t81_limb_booth_mul.cpp and test_t81_limb_mul_wide_high.cpp
workloads.proposed_measurement_method: Google Benchmark CPU execution timing per iteration batch (4096 ops)
workloads.environment_requirements: Single thread pinned, CPU frequency locked, binary comparator BM_LimbMul_Booth_Binary excluded
workloads.freeze_overlap: Investigated under H02; binary speedup claims excluded per closure findings.

workloads.purpose: Packed 2-bit SWAR logic operations across vector lengths N in [256, 65536]
workloads.correctness_oracle: Equivalence verification between SWAR backend, scalar loop, and reference logic in tests/cpp/test_tritwise_backend_equivalence.cpp
workloads.proposed_measurement_method: Google Benchmark wall-clock timing with DoNotOptimize memory barriers
workloads.environment_requirements: x86_64 or AArch64 binary host, T81_TRITWISE_PROFILE=OFF asserted
workloads.freeze_overlap: Historical archive baseline results recorded in benchmarks/results/archive/benchmark_results_release.txt

workloads.purpose: TISC interpreter execution latency and state determinism across tiered computational programs
workloads.correctness_oracle: 64-bit state signature hash over all 48 registers, tags, PC, SP, trace size, and Axion log count in tests/cpp/vm_workload_determinism_tiers_test.cpp
workloads.proposed_measurement_method: In-process monotonic timer measuring duration per 10,000 interpreter instruction cycles with post-run hash assertion
workloads.environment_requirements: Single isolated physical core, Linux/macOS host
workloads.freeze_overlap: None. Independent of CMP3 and H04-R03.

workloads.purpose: Hanoi in-memory kernel lifecycle command execution latency (boot, status, optimize, simulate, snapshot, rollback)
workloads.correctness_oracle: RFC-0000 Section 7 assertion suite verifying status booleans, snapshot counts, and trace records in tests/cpp/hanoi_command_surface_test.cpp
workloads.proposed_measurement_method: Monotonic wall-clock measurement per complete lifecycle command sequence
workloads.freeze_overlap: Traced to Hanoi CWEB lineage; hosted C++ implementation isolated from physical/radix claims.

workloads.purpose: PMU hardware branch misprediction measurement of CMP3 three-state branch vs binary jumps
workloads.environment_requirements: Bare-metal Linux host with accessible PMU

workloads.purpose: In-memory content-addressed block write and read throughput with CanonHash SHA3 verification
workloads.correctness_oracle: Content-addressable hash invariance and byte-for-byte read equality in tests/cpp/canonfs_driver_test.cpp
workloads.proposed_measurement_method: Google Benchmark throughput calculation via SetBytesProcessed over 4KiB, 64KiB, 1MiB blocks
workloads.environment_requirements: Single isolated thread, sufficient physical memory to avoid page swapping
workloads.freeze_overlap: Subsystem performance benchmark; independent from H04-R03.

workloads.purpose: Filesystem-backed persistent directory block write, fsync, and read-back latency under Axion policy
workloads.correctness_oracle: Cross-driver instance read-back verification and Axion policy check enforcement in tests/cpp/canonfs_persistent_driver_test.cpp
workloads.proposed_measurement_method: Google Benchmark wall-clock timing including disk sync barriers
workloads.environment_requirements: Dedicated isolated scratch filesystem to avoid disk queue contention

workloads.purpose: Axion authorization check latency on block-backed mutations (Publish, Revoke, Repair)
workloads.correctness_oracle: Axion hook callback interception counts in unmerged PR #686

workloads.purpose: Process-level peak resident set size (ru_maxrss), CPU time (utime+stime), and monotonic wall time
workloads.correctness_oracle: POSIX getrusage monotonic non-decreasing counter invariants
workloads.proposed_measurement_method: Pre- and post-trial getrusage(RUSAGE_SELF) sampling normalized to KiB
workloads.environment_requirements: POSIX-compliant kernel (Linux or macOS with unit normalization)
workloads.freeze_overlap: Directly contextualized by H04-R03 enforcement feasibility findings on Linux RSS tracking

workloads.purpose: Static compiled binary footprint, section breakdown (.text, .rodata, .data, .bss), and CAS blob sizes
workloads.correctness_oracle: Exact file stat byte count and SHA-256 binary digest verification
workloads.proposed_measurement_method: Direct filesystem stat and ELF/Mach-O section header inspection
workloads.environment_requirements: Host filesystem, consistent Release build without debug symbols
